cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the open side door of a camper van parked by a lake at night — perched on a ledge or edge; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a western coastal signal tower with an open gallery and a large brass viewing telescope on a fixed stand — she is a signal-keeper taking a break after looking through the telescope; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — kneeling on the ground; an esports arena — rests a pair of inflatable cheering sticks against her shoulder; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — lying on her front; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her left side; a mirrored dance — carries her keepsake low at her side; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height
